observations: The managed E1 execution path completed successfully.
The test crossed the real database queue, candidate persistence, evaluation, and finalization boundaries.
The LLM mutation boundary was replaced with a deterministic mutator, so this run does not verify live LLM mutation.
The dataset was synthetic, so the resulting fitness and overfitting classification are execution evidence rather than evidence of strategy quality.
The production DataClient and FrozenBarsLoader path was intentionally bypassed by injecting a controlled FrozenDataset.
